title: claude-settings' ux/ folder moves to docs/design/
why: Left out of o2's lane 2 (Oct 26): the rest of claude-settings' records moved under docs/, but ux/ did not.
note: Draft PR #658 (move the house UX rules to docs/design/) is up, and Sonnet review round 1 is running. The guard now matches a frozen dir as a path prefix, because docs/design is two levels deep. New guard cases fail on main (3) and pass on the branch. Both installers remove the old ~/.claude/ux links and folder. The agents' read paths stay paths (~/.claude/docs/design/...), because docs/decisions is not installed and a slug cite would not resolve in other repos. No conflict with PR #657 (the guard refuses record cites). Needs no answer from you: the same-folders ruling (o2, Oct 22) covers it. Port: no; child repos follow o2's roll-out.
